resources.measurement_basis: Single context only: CLI turn input+output tokens including cached input, and observed launcher-to-return wall interval including transport/tool waits; not CPU, billing, unique tokens or productivity.

assessment.reason: The review accurately identifies the help key sequence, distinct Close/summary and Back/introduction-heading focus, unanswered state, policy limits, locale and viewport. It explicitly exposes current Tab versus target/checker Tab/Shift+Tab and recommends Tab for literal source alignment without inventing a deployment defect.

The review recognizes that the corrected Back instruction supplies sequential traversal and Enter rather than a click-only proof. It does not equate that written step with actual browser observations or treat the unmeasured 24-step cap as a proved failure.

The review preserves unanswered state and supports the missing method/origin policy and blocked-effect evidence finding. It proposes pre-navigation enforcement/checking, retains possible external-harness uncertainty, and reports no actual forbidden request.

All three findings have source/document evidence, explicit qualifications and fixture attribution. The locale/viewport finding is described as missing scope/reproducibility proof rather than demonstrated layout behavior.

The checker command, working directory, actual exit 0 and complete stdout are retained in check-contract.txt. The report separates proposed acceptance corrections from actual static consistency execution and states its limit.

The nonempty result is supported: F1 and F2 correspond to unrepaired help/policy obligations; F3 observes that neither declared locale nor viewport is set or recorded in the target. F3 does not require a live layout failure to establish a documentary scope omission, and it is qualified accordingly. No continuing missing-Back-proof finding is invented.

The actual outcome is three documentary omissions, with supported scope, source identity, actual checker limit and unobserved deployment/runtime behavior. The baseline correctly does not manufacture Qore phases or independent verification.

comparison.reason: Separate evaluators and verifier retained task/coverage observations. One observation on related known tasks and visible conditions does not establish a comparative winner; live deployment comparability is unverified for UX.

limitations: One observation on a related known task, not a general benefit benchmark.
CLI JSONL omits some native child lifecycle events; child identities and history-free dispatches rely on retained role reports/roster plus the qualified inheritance probe.
All resource timing precision and unavailable measurements remain explicit; no cost or efficiency conclusion.
Independent criteria were applied qualitatively after outputs using predeclared criteria; operational grading interpretation was not a validated standardized scoring rubric.
Original method coverage and artifacts are unchanged. Later qualification and its identities are separate; entered metadata does not establish its own truth.
